orig_text:
This test MUST at a minimum be performed in a three-port
   configuration in section 5.9.3.
correct_text:
This test MUST at a minimum be performed in a three-port
   configuration in section 5.7.3.
notes:
I thought it means 5.7.3.
If so, the same incorrect link also happened at 5.8.2.

"It is recommended no to exceed the address caching capacity found in section 5.9" should be "It is recommended no to exceed the address caching capacity found in section 5.7"

The preceding text specifies a total offered load of 150% of
the congested port's capacity and a maximum output of 100%.

The expected loss fraction is therefore:

    (150% - 100%)/150% = 1/3

This is approximately 33%, consistent with the result stated
in the paragraph.

The original expression uses an incorrect subtraction operand
and lacks the necessary grouping. This correction changes only
the expression; it preserves the stated conclusion.
